tips_en: Read Paper 1 first: its Platonic representation theorem and good-view/bad-view distinction provide the broadest conceptual framework, while the claimed 42× sample-efficiency gain makes the idealized assumptions especially worth scrutinizing. Next, read LOWN for the practical efficiency counterpart, followed by OmniShowcase, which addresses a distinct consistency challenge—preserving identity and 3D geometry across viewpoints—while sharing the broader theme of coherent multimodal generation.
tips_zh: 建议先读论文1：其“柏拉图式表示”定理及好视角/坏视角区分提供了最具普适性的理论框架，而约42倍的样本效率提升也使其理想化假设尤其值得审视。随后可读LOWN，了解多模态生成中的推理效率优化，再读OmniShowcase，它聚焦跨视角保持身份与3D几何一致性这一不同问题；三篇论文共同体现了多模态生成中的一致性与效率主题。
